title: 第1章 系统到来第2章 杨康
content_zh:
影视快穿合集最新章节_第1章 系统到来第1页_影视快穿合集慕凝汐_热点小说网
> 第1章 系统到来（第1页）
宁宁本来正在看着最近热播的电视剧，突然听到“叮咚”的声音，不过也没有多想，但是看着电视剧的情节，终于忍不住骂出声来。
“为什么这些电视剧的内容越来越让人不忍直视呢？合着只有主角的痛苦是痛苦，其他人的就什么都不是了吗？原来的那个三生三世，还有香蜜，现在的......"
"影视中心系统，编号3690为您服务，检测到您对当前影视环境存在怨念，现在我将随您一起去改变，您愿意吗？”
宁宁这才意识到自己刚刚原来没有听错，身为网文骨灰粉的她，自然知道现在爆火的穿越时空，虽然很心动，但还是问到，“为什么是我，而且你有什么要求吗？我不信有免费的午餐”
3690回答到：“影视环境的不健康，严重影响了当前的三观环境，也为我们的工作带来了不便，所以我需要找人和我一起改变，但我仅仅只能提供给您选择时空的权力，至于逆天的金手指是没有的，毕竟我们也要保障衍生世界的公平合理。同时这也可以圆您心中的梦，难道不是一举两得吗？您也可以把它们当成一场梦，一场兼职，和您现实生活并不冲突，当然我们是提供薪水的、”
宁宁听到它这么说，更加心动了，因为她真心很喜欢有些影视人物，也为他们的结局感到不公。既然能有机会改变，那当然不能错过了，就当自己梦游了。
于是兴奋的说到：“那我们走吧，但是选择时空的权力在我！”
3690没想到她这么快就同意，于是补充到：“可以，但是衍生时空从网友投票的前五名选择，时空矫正的程度决定您的薪水，由系统进行评估，希望您能理解。”
宁宁倒是不介意这个，于是说道：“那我们开始选吧。”
宁宁看着这结果，直接懵了，于是说到：“等会，不会都是宫斗组合吧？没其他的吗？”
3690也愣了一下，说到："有其他的，当宫斗是最火的世界，我以为您会喜欢，要不您先选一下分组，有宫斗，修仙，武侠，都市，还有....."
宁宁想都没想，直接选了童年最爱，"武侠，我要武侠"
“好的，正在为您创建世界，请稍后。”
“杨康的心愿——面对生恩养恩，国仇家恨，我好像怎么选都不对，我只想做自己！杨康也好，完颜康也罢，这两个名字对我来说太过沉重！我想为自己活一次！”
宁宁来到异世，瞬间感觉整个人都不太好了！
她一个清清白白的小姑娘，为什么变成男的了呢？
“不是，3690，我怎么换性别了呢?"
“您不是自己选择了杨康吗？这肯定要换性别啊！”

我以为是成为配角，帮杨康改变命运，你直接让我变成杨康，这差的太远了吧？？
3690解释道：成为杨康是最直接的方式，配角那种太慢了！

The latest chapter of the film and television quick-travel collection_Chapter 1 The arrival of the system Page 1_Mu Ningxi, the film and television quick-travel collection_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1 System Arrival (Page 1)
Ning Ning was watching a recently popular TV series when she suddenly heard the sound of "ding dong", but she didn't think much about it, but after watching the plot of the TV series, she finally couldn't help but curse out loud.
"Why are the contents of these TV dramas becoming more and more unbearable to watch? Only the pain of the protagonist is pain, and the pain of others is nothing? The original Three Lives, Three Worlds, and Xiangmi, and now..."
"The film and television center system, number 3690, is at your service. It has been detected that you have resentment towards the current film and television environment. Now I will work with you to change it. Are you willing?"
Only then did Ning Ning realize that she had heard correctly. As a fan of Internet literature, she naturally knew about the popular time travel. Although she was very excited, she still asked, "Why me, and do you have any request? I don't believe in free lunches."
3690 replied: "The unhealthy film and television environment has seriously affected the current three-dimensional environment, and has also brought inconvenience to our work, so I need to find people to change with me, but I can only provide you with the power to choose time and space. As for the golden finger that defies heaven, No, after all, we also need to ensure that the derivative world is fair and reasonable. At the same time, this can also fulfill your dreams. Isn’t it killing two birds with one stone? You can also treat them as a dream and a part-time job that does not conflict with your real life. Of course, we will provide a salary.”
Ning Ning was even more moved when she heard what it said, because she really liked some film and television characters and felt unfair for their endings. Since you have the opportunity to change, of course you can't miss it and just pretend that you are sleepwalking.
So he said excitedly: "Then let's go, but the power to choose time and space is mine!"
3690 did not expect that she would agree so quickly, so he added: "Yes, but the derivative time and space will be selected from the top five voted by netizens. The degree of time and space correction determines your salary, which will be evaluated by the system. I hope you can understand."
Ning Ning didn't mind this, so she said, "Then let's start choosing."
Ning Ning was stunned when she saw the result, so she said: "Wait a minute, won't they all be Gong Dou combinations? Isn't there anyone else?"
3690 was also stunned for a moment and said: "There are others. Palace fighting is the most popular world. I thought you would like it. How about you choose a group first? There are palace fighting, immortal cultivation, martial arts, city, and..."
Ning Ning didn't even think about it and directly chose her childhood favorite, "Martial arts, I want martial arts."
"Okay, the world is being created for you, please wait."
"Yang Kang's wish - facing the hatred of the country and the family, I can't seem to make the right choice. I just want to be myself! Be it Yang Kang or Wan Yankang, these two names are too heavy for me! I want to live for myself once!"
Ning Ning came to another world and instantly felt that her whole body was not in a good condition!
Why did she, an innocent little girl, turn into a boy?
"No, 3690, why did I change my gender?"
"Didn't you choose Yang Kang yourself? This will definitely require a gender change!"
I thought it was to become a supporting role and help Yang Kang change his destiny. You just let me become Yang Kang. Isn't this too far off? ?
3690 explained: Becoming Yang Kang is the most direct way, the supporting role is too slow!
